boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-East Bay
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops in Hayward with directly verified late operating hours.

cards.title: Tailfeather Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 926 B St, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted hours to time a downtown pickup or meal, and confirm service details directly before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A B Street restaurant whose official site lists service through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Tailfeather Kitchen’s official site lists its Hayward address at 926 B St and business hours ending at 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists business hours through 12:00 a.m.; check the page for the applicable day before visiting.

cards.title: Denny's on Industrial Parkway
cards.subtitle: 30163 Industrial Parkway Southwest, Hayward
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, pickup, or delivery as offered, and use the location page to reconfirm its all-day listing before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Hayward Denny’s location with posted near-24-hour daily service.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official location page lists this Hayward restaurant’s hours as 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m. and offers dine-in, pickup, and delivery.

cards.title: McDonald's on West A Street
cards.subtitle: 355 W A St, Hayward
cards.notes: For a late drive-through order, check the official location page and use its listed drive-through schedule rather than lobby hours.
cards.short_summary: A West A Street stop with later drive-through hours than its lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists drive-through service at 355 W A St until 12:30 a.m. most nights and 2:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-through hours to 12:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; lobby closes earlier.

cards.title: Carl's Jr. on Mission Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 20550 Mission Blvd, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the official location listing to plan a drive-through stop, especially when visiting on the later Thursday through Saturday schedule.
cards.short_summary: Mission Boulevard fast food with midnight and 1 a.m. posted closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl’s Jr. lists this Hayward location open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 1:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 12:00 a.m. closings Sunday–Wednesday and 1:00 a.m. closings Thursday–Saturday; drive-through is listed.

cards.title: Express Pizza
cards.subtitle: 505 A St #B, Hayward
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s current online schedule, then select carryout or delivery for an A Street option near Hayward Station.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza shop whose own site posts late carryout and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Express Pizza lists Friday and Saturday business, carryout, and delivery hours until midnight at 505 A Street #B.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday business, carryout, and delivery hours of 11:00 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Wendy's on Mission Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 23969 Mission Blvd, Hayward
cards.notes: Confirm the posted location hours before going, then use the restaurant or drive-through service listed on Wendy’s official page.
cards.short_summary: A Mission Boulevard restaurant with a uniform 1 a.m. schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-through hours of 6:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. daily at 23969 Mission Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists both restaurant and drive-through service until 1:00 a.m. every day.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 25198 Hesperian Blvd
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Hesperian Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 25198 Hesperian Blvd, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the drive-through schedule for a late stop; the official page distinguishes it from the earlier-closing lobby schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Hesperian Boulevard drive-through with posted service until 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists drive-through hours of 4:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. daily at 25198 Hesperian Blvd; its lobby closes at 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 25198 Hesperian Blvd, Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-through hours continuously to 4:00 a.m.; lobby hours are 6:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger on Harder Avenue
cards.subtitle: 709 Harder Ave, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the official location page to verify the day’s closing time, then choose the listed drive-through or dine-in seating option.
cards.short_summary: A Harder Avenue burger stop with late-night hours posted by the company.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out’s official Hayward page lists 709 Harder Ave and shows service until 1:00 a.m. on the displayed daily schedule.
cards.access_notes: Official location page identifies drive-through and dine-in seating and displays a 1:00 a.m. closing time; reconfirm the day’s schedule.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Jackson Street
cards.subtitle: 215 W Jackson St, Hayward
cards.notes: Plan for the drive-through when arriving late, because the official page lists a later drive-through schedule than dine-in service.
cards.short_summary: A West Jackson Street drive-through listed until 4 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-through hours of 7:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. every day at 215 W Jackson Street in Hayward.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 215 W Jackson St, Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-through hours until 4:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours may differ, so check before visiting.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Mission Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 22859 Mission Blvd, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the location page to choose delivery or carryout, with extra attention to the later Friday and Saturday listed closing times.
cards.short_summary: A Mission Boulevard pizza location with service listed through midnight or 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists restaurant hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 22859 Mission Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists delivery and carryout hours to midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
